name: qci-pqc regression ratchet
note: Ratchet gates (everything except the policy limits below) are floors: on testbench 1.17 each is the better of QCI v2.2 and v2.3, measured on the stamped release, so a ratchet never moves down because a later release regressed; raise them when a release improves a number. cbom_schema_valid (the scanner's own cbom.json must validate against CycloneDX 1.6) and the two holdout gates are fixed policy limits that --rebaseline never moves: overfit_gap_ci_low fails when the published score beats a private holdout by more than sampling noise; negative_fp_gap fails when freshly generated negative controls draw more than 0.5 extra false positives per file than the published ones (calibrated on 24 negatives in six languages, five seeds: grep -0.01 to +0.24, QCI 0.3.0 -0.27 to +0.15, v0.7 +0.72 to +1.18). Both apply only when CBOM_HOLDOUT_SEED is set. Every gate is a required measurement: one that is absent makes the run 'not evaluated' (exit 3), unless the gate carries when_missing: skip with a reason, or the run was made with --without-holdout, in which case it is listed as skipped.

library_pq_verdict_accuracy.reason: the scanner gave no PQC-capability verdicts for libraries, so there is nothing to judge
